items.label: One line
items.text: The Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) is the business organization that brings together government, academia, and industry so that building a tech company in Puebla is easier.

items.label: One paragraph
items.text: The Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) is the business organization that connects government, academia, and industry so tech startups in Puebla can be created and scaled. It has operated as a network since 2021 and was formally established on June 15, 2026, with its office in San Andrés Cholula. More at clusterdestartups.org.

items.label: Short text
items.text: The Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) is a business organization based in San Andrés Cholula, Puebla. It brings together government, academia, and industry under the triple-helix model so that creating and scaling a tech startup in the state is easier. The network has operated since 2021. It was formally established on June 15, 2026, and on June 23 of that year the Ministry of Economic Development and Labor of the State of Puebla recognized it as an interlocutor of the innovation ecosystem. Its mission is to create connections, infrastructure, and institutional support so startups from Puebla can scale. Its vision is that, by 2030, starting a tech-based company will be easier than opening a traditional business, and that Puebla will be a Latin American benchmark for innovation. Contact: hola@clusterdestartups.org.

rules.title: Logo rules
items: Do not recolor, stretch, rotate, crop, or add a shadow, outline, or background.
The reversed logo belongs only on a dark background with enough contrast.
Leave clear space around it at least as tall as the word “de”.
On screen, the wordmark stays at least 120 px wide.
Do not retype it in Archivo, Raleway, or any other font: use the file.

brand.title: Color and type
brand.description: The logo inks and the interface pink are different colors. Do not swap one for the other.
brand.typeNote: Archivo and Raleway are the site fonts. The wordmark is not rebuilt with them.
